paite: Simon Peter, Jesu Khrist sikha leh sawltak in, i Pathian leh Hondampa Jesu Khrist diktatna ziak a ginna manphatak i tan bang tang samte kiang ah:
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: Pathian leh Jesu i Toupa theihna ah hehpihna leh khamuanna noute ah hihkhan in om hen.
Ama thupina leh hoihna ziak a hon sampa, atanchin theih ziak in ama Pathianna thilhihtheihna in hinna leh Pathian limsakna lam thu ah thil tengteng ahon peta hi.
heading: Pathian Sapna Leh Telna

paite: Huaite ziak in athuchiam manphatak leh thupi mahmahte ahon pia hi; huchi in utna ziak a khovel a siatna hong om taikhiaksan in; huai thuchiam manphatak leh thupi mahmahte ziak in Pathian omdan na kikoppih thei sam ding uhi.
Ahi, huaiziak tak in, thanop himhim suah in, na ginna uah hoihna hel unla, na hoihna uah theihna hel unla,
heading: Khristian Omdan Kilawm

paite: na theihna uah kidekna hel unla, na kidekna uah kuhkalna hel unla, na kuhkalna uah Pathian limsakna hel unla,
na Pathian limsakna uah unaute itna hel unla, na unaute itna ah itna hel un.
Hiai hoihnate nou a ahih a, akhan zelleh i Toupa Jesu Khrist theihna lam ah thadah lou leh gah lou lou in nou ahon bawl ding hi.
Kuapeuh huai thilte nei lou mittaw, naichikte kia mu thei, anidanglai khelhnate siansakna mangngilhte ahi uhi.
Huaiziak in unaute aw, nou ahon sapna leh ahon telna hihkip ding in thanop suah semsem un; huaite na hih uleh chik lai mah in na puk kei ding uhi.
Huchi in Jesu Khrist i Toupa leh Hondampa'n tangtawn gam a lutna ahon musak lo mahmah ding hi.
Huaiziak in huai thilte nei in na kiang ua om thutak a phuhkip hita mah le uchin, huai thutak mah ka hon theisak nawn ding hi.
heading: Thutak A Kiphuhkipna

paite: Huan hiai pumpi a ka om lai teng noumau hon theihpih in hon tohhalh gige hoih ka sa hi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist in hon theihsak bang in ka pumpi puanin koihkhiak hun ding hong tung pah ding chih ka thei hi.
Ahi ka paikhiak nung in huai thilte na theihgigena ding un ka kisuk ding hi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist thilhihtheihna leh ahong paina thu ka hon theihsak lai un, tangthu piltak a ngaihtuahkhiak phet zui ka hi kei ua, athupina mute ka hi zaw uhi.
heading: Zawlneite Leh Peter Theihpihna / (Mat 17.5; Mar 9.7; Luk 9.52)

paite: Ama'n Pa Pathian kiang a kipan in pahtawina leh thupina amu a, huchih lai in thupina thupitak a kipan in hichibang aw akiang ahong tung hi, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi," chi in.
Huan tang siangthou a akiang a ka om ziak un huai aw van a kipan a hong suak koumau ngei in ka za uhi.
Huchi in genkholhna thu kip nawn sem i nei uhi. Khua ahong vak a, zingsol aksi na lungtang ua ahong suah masiah hiai thu khawnvak mun mial a vak alimsak bang ua, na limsak uleh na hihhoih ding uhi.
Laisiangthou a thugenkholh himhim eimah kihilhchet ding ahi kei chih thei masa un.
Thugenkholh himhim mihing thu a pawt ahi ngei kei a, mite'n Kha Siangthou sawl in, Pathian a kipan agen zaw uhi.
